units.source_text: "对、对不起，刚、刚才听课有、有些地方不明白，我。

en.t: I-I’m sorry, but there were some parts of the lecture just now that I didn’t understand.
I would like to ask you about them.

units.source_text: 哦用标准语结结巴巴地说。

en.t: O said this haltingly in standard speech.

units.source_text: 因为我想，既然上了大学，就应该讲标准语了。

en.t: Because I thought that, now that I was at university, I ought to speak standard speech.
